data.long_meaning: Gyanchand is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Gyana’ (knowledge) and ‘Chandra’ (moon). This name is associated with the god Chandra, who is considered the god of knowledge and wisdom. The name Gyanchand signifies a learned and wise individual. The name Gyanchand carries the meaning “Learned, Wise, Knowledgeable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gyanchand usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, wise, knowledgeable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name embodies the values of knowledge and learning, which are highly valued in Hindu culture.
